title: AI assistant
intro: Use your own local or cloud model service.
name: Connection name
secretHint: Leave blank to keep the saved credential. Credentials cannot be displayed.
temporaryCredential: Keep this credential only until the app quits
storageError: Not saved. Keep this window open to preserve the unsaved text.
deleteDescription: Its messages and drafts will be deleted from this device. Model connections remain unchanged.
clearDescription: All AI conversations and drafts on this device will be deleted. Model connections and credentials will be kept.
deleteConnectionDescription: Its credential and default selection will be removed. Saved conversations remain readable.
emptyDescription: Understand your device using the data you choose to share.
disabled: AI is turned off. Saved conversations remain available.
missingModel: Choose a default model in settings to start chatting.
deletedModel: This conversation's model connection is no longer available. Choose another model to continue.
enterHint: Enter to send · Shift + Enter for a new line
sendNotice: Only the displayed content and included conversation history will be sent.
sourceExpired: Source data was cleared. This message will not be reused as context.
modelChange: If this conversation already has messages, changing the model starts a new conversation. The current conversation is kept, and its history is not sent to the new model.
testHint: Uses a short test message only. Your service may charge for the request.
capabilitiesTitle: Checks for this connection and model
capabilityParameters: Test parameters: streaming {{stream}}, output limit {{tokens}} tokens
capabilityScopeHint: Records apply only to this saved connection and selected model. Streaming reflects the parameter used for the test, not all modes. Tools are not available.
capabilityAddressHint: Address validation checks configuration only; it does not confirm connectivity or offline processing.
resultEvidenceHint: Values and units below come from this device. Evidence links do not guarantee that the model’s explanation is correct.
resultUnlinked: Not linked to evidence item by item. Treat this reply as an unverified model explanation.
processingNotice: Your service may charge for this request. A local connection address does not prove offline processing.
baseSuggestion: This looks like a full generation URL. Review the suggested API base before saving.
ollamaHelpHint: Use the official Ollama guide to install it, start its service and prepare a model. CoreRobin does not run these setup steps.
providerPoliciesHint: Data handling depends on your chosen service and its policy. Review the documentation for other providers before sending.
saveFirst: Save the connection before checking models.
modelsEmpty: No models returned. You can still enter a model ID.
defaultSaved: The default model was saved. Existing conversations keep their current model.
savedConnection: Connection saved. No model request was sent.
proxyHint: A configured proxy can receive model requests. Localhost connections always bypass proxies.
storageWarning: Conversation storage is almost full. Clear records or increase the budget.
temporaryHint: Temporary conversations are not saved and disappear when the app quits.
busy: Another reply is being generated. Wait or stop it before sending.
draftConflict: Another window updated this draft. Your input is kept. Load the saved version or explicitly replace it with your draft.
networkHint: Only localhost allows HTTP. Remote servers require HTTPS.
noAutoSwitch: If this model fails, Robin will not switch to another service.
suggestNetwork: Help me understand my network check
saveFailed: Could not save. Nothing was sent.
sourceCopiesRemain: Saved AI conversations may still contain copies of this data.
clearProductScope: AI conversations, model connections and credentials
localConnectionsOnly: Only allow services on this device
localConnectionsHint: This restricts service addresses. It does not guarantee that Ollama or another local service will not use the cloud.
saveChangesFirst: Save your connection changes before making a model request.
credentialChanged: The destination or authentication changed. Enter the credential again to use it with this connection.
modelExplanation: Model explanation · Check the supporting evidence
missingCredential: This connection needs a credential. Add it in AI settings.
connectionError: The model service could not complete this request.
settingsError: Check the AI configuration and try again.
privacyClearing: Data is being cleared. Wait for cleanup to finish, then try again.
keepMyDraft: Overwrite the saved version with my draft
proxyTargetUnverified: The proxy resolves the model server address. Its final IP cannot be verified by CoreRobin.
openEvidenceSource: View source data and recording settings
copyConnectionHint: Only connection settings are copied. Add a credential separately.
toolTrashRisk: Moves items only to the system trash. This may affect applications and may not immediately free space.
toolProcessRisk: Unsaved work may be lost. Process identity is checked again before execution; a close request does not prove the process exited.
toolConfirmationExpired: Confirmation expired. No action was performed.
toolScope: Robin can inspect devices and processes, probe the network and scan common folders for your task. Deleting or stopping processes needs confirmation.
toolPreviewScope: This previews the initial message only. Later tools may read process names and file usage; actual results appear in the task steps.
